reason: This plugin is primarily a DSH web mobile UX styling plugin that adjusts narrow-screen layout behavior through injected CSS, including question/plan footers, top tabs, input bars, settings panel structure, directory columns, and related panel controls; evidence from the repository description, README, and package metadata shows the effect is UI-only and client-side.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 网页端的客户端插件，在窄屏下通过样式覆盖统一修正多个界面组件的布局与溢出问题，提升移动端显示体验。
summaries.en: This is a client-side DSH web plugin that applies unified CSS overrides for narrow screens to adjust layout and overflow behavior across multiple UI components on mobile.

capabilities: Injects client-side CSS overrides into the DSH web UI
Applies responsive rules for narrow screens (max-width: 768px)
Dynamically adapts to runtime CSS-module class names to reduce breakage on updates
Implements fixes through style overrides rather than host/server modifications
